Operational efficiency and capital returns are weak, evidenced by a 10-year median ROE of just 3% and an ROCE of 5.32% that trails the sector benchmark of 17.27% [E10, E26]. Top-line expansion is stagnant over longer horizons with a 10-year compounded sales growth of -5% and 3-year growth at 0%, accompanied by structural headwinds like high debtors of 175 days [E14, E16, E66]. Accounting flags further taint the earnings quality, including a low tax rate, zero dividend yield, and the risk that the company might be capitalizing interest costs [E4, E61, E63, E65]. Market sentiment reflects these fundamental pressures as the stock sits below both its 50-day and 200-day moving averages with a lagging relative-strength rating of 27 and a 1-year price return of -32% [E25, E50, E51].
